title: Adapted protocol to extract total RNA using TRIzol®
author: Talita B Gagliardi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w8vfhw6
materials: In a microfuge tube: 750ul of TRIzol (Invitrogen, Thermo)+ 250ul of sample

steps.title: Incubate homogenized sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the homogenized sample for 5 min at room temperature (r.t.).

steps.title: Add chloroform and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of chloroform to the tube, vortex vigorously for 15 sec, then incubate for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge to separate phases
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 15 min at 12,000 × g and 4 °C to achieve phase separation.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, the tube contains a red lower phenol‑chloroform phase, an interphase, and a colorless upper aqueous phase; carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube (RNA remains in this phase).

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 375 µL of isopropanol to the aqueous phase and mix gently.

steps.title: Centrifuge RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 min at 12,000 × g and 4 °C to pellet the RNA.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 75% ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of 75 % ethanol to the RNA pellet, then centrifuge for 5 min at 7,500 × g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA in RNase‑free water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 30 µL of RNase‑free H₂O and incubate at 55–60 °C.

steps.title: Store RNA at –70 °C
steps.instruction: Store the purified RNA at –70 °C until further use.
